name: stifling-trap-memory-alt-cost-own-turn-not-offered
notes: Stifling Trap (z5exbwdp7q): "[Class Bonus] If it's not your turn, you may remove two preparation counters from your champion to activate this card from your memory without paying its reserve cost." "If it's not your turn". Player 1 (Tristan, Hired Blade, ASSASSIN, 2 preparation counters, Stifling Trap in memory, Fairy Whispers in hand to open windows) ends its OWN turn; in its own end-of-turn window the offered options are only the hand card (live: MZMAYCHOOSE=myHand-7) and answering with myMemory-0 is rejected -- the alternate cost is not available on the player's own turn. A rejected click can be a no-op, so the state is asserted: counters, memory and graveyard are unchanged.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] If it's not your turn, you may remove two preparation counters from your champion to activate this card from your memory without paying its reserve cost.
